description.value: Basalt Wine & Salumeria is a dine-in restaurant and wine bar located in the heart of Whistler Village, describing itself as 'Authentic. Lively. Local.' The salumeria focus suggests a menu centred on cured meats, charcuterie, and wine. Outdoor seating makes it a pleasant stop after a ride through the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page for basaltwhistler confirms the business is real and active in Whistler Village, listing an address, phone, email, and its own website (basaltwhistler.com). The page explicitly lists 'In-store pickup' as a service, confirming takeout. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content. The OSM name 'Basalt Wine' is a truncation of the full business name 'Basalt Wine & Salumeria' shown on Facebook.
concerns: OSM name 'Basalt Wine' is a truncation; the full business name per Facebook is 'Basalt Wine & Salumeria'.

OSM website field points to the Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/basaltwhistler/) rather than the business's own website (https://www.basaltwhistler.com/) — contact_confirmed.website set to false to flag discrepancy.
OSM record lacks address and phone; both sourced from Facebook page only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible restaurant in Whistler Village with confirmed contact details, reviews, and active Facebook presence. A useful stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: dine-in restaurant and wine bar located in the heart of Whistler Village
